entries.7e7aa11ac324762a: Planning, manufacture and sale of uniforms and menswear
entries.8c3fd2efe137aced: Returning to the basics of uniforms, 'If it is not complete, it cannot be called a uniform', and aiming to revive 'the complete JICHODO', it will focus on reorganizing and strengthening its production structure, regain customer trust, and work to reduce lost sales opportunities and restore its performance. Based on its basic philosophy of 'supporting people who work', it will strengthen the development and sale of products that workers want, including products that combine functionality and design as workwear, products with price appeal, and products that address SDGs and sustainability.

entries.a4bf7cbc6e727f53: It plans, manufactures and sells uniforms such as work clothing, medical white coats, safety shoes and menswear. In response to rising temperatures and companies being required to take heatstroke countermeasures, it is also strengthening the development and sale of heatstroke countermeasure products such as the electric fan-equipped wear 'Kūchōfuku'.
entries.a86d662b23ff00a5: It is an apparel manufacturer founded in 1924 in Fukuyama, Hiroshima Prefecture. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange; as of June 30, 2026, its consolidated number of employees was 179, and the group consists of two consolidated subsidiaries and two affiliates.

entries.df65fde542c2a944: Sales agents and the users beyond them
entries.e135565426855d2e: Under a stockholding structure in which the manufacturer itself holds product inventory based on demand forecasts and delivers immediately against orders placed through sales agents, its strength lies in a 'complete' range of sizes and item numbers. It also has its own weaving and sewing plants and sewing plants of its subsidiary, with a structure that handles everything from planning through manufacturing to sales.
entries.e6d196b9d3477743: This is the Group's single-segment business, planning, manufacturing and selling uniforms and menswear. The company and its consolidated subsidiary Genkai Sewing Co., Ltd. are responsible for integrated production and assembly of parts, and its consolidated subsidiary Lion-ya Co., Ltd. is responsible for sales of work clothing and work supplies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥13,275 million.
